SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Endpoints
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Port configuration, TLS version policy, WAF toggles, and certificate assignment.
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.always_strip_note: Certificate/key material (ssl_certificate, encrypted_ssl_private_key, AES keys) and the app CNAME are always removed. Per-port ca_name and waf_container_exposed_port are also always stripped.

sub_sections.label: TLS Version Settings
sub_sections.note: TLS 1.0–1.3 enable flags, cipher suite, PFS — safe to import.

sub_sections.label: Advanced WAF / Session Settings
sub_sections.note: Session timeout, HTTP/2, WebSocket, fingerprinting, proxy-list toggles.

sub_sections.label: Port Definitions
sub_sections.note: Port number, protocol, per-port advanced config. ca_name and container port stripped.

sub_sections.label: Certificate Management Flags
sub_sections.warning: Only use_automatic and enable_container_secret are included — all certificate/key material is always stripped.

sub_sections.label: Region / Deployment Settings
sub_sections.warning: Primary/secondary region selection is account-level — may conflict with target.

sub_sections.label: Domain List
sub_sections.warning: Source app domains — almost certainly wrong for a different target app.

sub_sections.label: SNI Certificates
sub_sections.warning: May contain certificate material encrypted for the source account.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Servers
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Backend server host/port, SSL to backend, health check config, and connection pool settings.
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.always_strip_note: Runtime fields (health, mode, backend_test_result, last_test_time) always stripped.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Allowed IPs
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Client IP/CIDR entries that bypass WAF inspection.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Bot Blocking
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Bot category blocking toggles (search engines, scrapers, scanners, GenAI, etc.).

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Client Evaluation (CAPTCHA)
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: CAPTCHA type, client risk scoring rules, and mouse-event detection.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Header Allow/Deny Rules
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Per-header injection detection, metacharacter blocking, and exception patterns.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: IP Reputation
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: GeoIP blocking, threat-intelligence categories, and per-IP allow exceptions.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Parameter Protection
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Request parameter validation, file upload limits, and injection detection for parameters.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Referer Spam
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Referer spam detection toggle and exception patterns.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Request Limits
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Maximum lengths for URL, query string, headers, cookies, and total request body.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Response Cloaking
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Status code normalisation and sensitive response header suppression.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Response Pages
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Custom HTML pages for blocked requests, CAPTCHA, login flows, and error responses.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Slow Client Prevention
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Timeouts and minimum data-rate thresholds for slow HTTP attack mitigation.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Tarpit Profile
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Request backlog limit and delay interval for tarpitting abusive clients.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Trusted Hosts
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Named IP entries that bypass WAF inspection (internal load balancers, monitoring, etc.).

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: URL Access & Redirect Rules
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: URL-level allow, deny, and redirect rules with extended match conditions.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: URL Protection
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Allowed HTTP methods, content types, CSRF protection, and URL-level injection detection.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Violation Responses
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Actions (block, tarpit, redirect) triggered when WAF violation risk scores exceed thresholds.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Web Scraping Policy
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: Bot scraping detection, hidden link injection, and JavaScript challenge settings.

SECTION_DEFINITIONS.label: Website Profile (Content Profiles)
SECTION_DEFINITIONS.description: URL-matched content type profiles for JSON, XML, and custom input validation policies.
